criteria.name: MASVS-STORAGE-1: No Plaintext Credentials in Logs
criteria.details: No authentication tokens, private keys, or passwords logged to Android logcat.

criteria.name: MASVS-CRYPTO-1: Industry Standard Authenticated Encryption
criteria.details: AES-GCM (Galois/Counter Mode) authenticated cipher used for tamper-evident encryption.

criteria.name: MASVS-CRYPTO-2: High Iteration Key Derivation (KDF)
criteria.details: PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256 with 100,000+ iterations enforced against brute-force.

criteria.name: MASVS-NETWORK-1: Cleartext Traffic Globally Forbidden
criteria.details: Cleartext HTTP traffic strictly disabled in Android manifest.

criteria.name: MASVS-PLATFORM-1: Zero Unauthorized Component Export
criteria.details: Background sync service explicitly unexported (exported="false") against IPC hijacking.

criteria.name: MASVS-PLATFORM-2: Immutable PendingIntents (Android 12+)
criteria.details: All Notification and Service PendingIntents use FLAG_IMMUTABLE, mitigating Intent redirection attacks.

criteria.name: EFF-1: Encrypted in Transit
criteria.details: All signaling and data channels enforce TLS 1.3 / HTTPS / WSS.

criteria.name: EFF-2: Encrypted End-to-End
criteria.details: Payloads are encrypted locally on the sender device before socket/RTDB transmission.

criteria.name: EFF-3: Provider Cannot Read Plaintext (Zero Knowledge)
criteria.details: Private keys never leave the client; operators cannot decrypt data even under subpoena.

criteria.name: EFF-4: Verification of Contact Fingerprints
criteria.details: Cryptographic safety number ceremony and key verification supported for anti-MITM.

criteria.name: EFF-5: Source Code Available for Independent Review
criteria.details: Full source code publicly accessible on GitHub (JJcoders00/jchatt).

criteria.name: EFF-6: Security Architecture Formally Documented
criteria.details: Formal Cryptographic & Architectural Whitepaper published on the web platform.

criteria.name: STORE-1: Zero Invasive Contact Scraping Permissions
criteria.details: No READ_CONTACTS or WRITE_CONTACTS permissions requested.

criteria.name: STORE-2: Zero Location Tracking Permissions
criteria.details: No geolocation or GPS permissions requested.

criteria.name: STORE-3: Live Accessible Privacy Policy Link
criteria.details: Dedicated Privacy Policy hosted via HTTPS at https://jjcodersjchatt.web.app/privacy.html.

criteria.name: STORE-4: Dedicated App Icon Launcher Drawables & Assets
criteria.details: Icons, branding assets, and installable release artifacts bundled.

criteria.name: STORE-5: Support for Multi-Screen Disguise / Discrete Mode
criteria.details: Disguise launcher aliases cleanly registered with PackageManager.

criteria.name: WCAG-1: Document Language Specified (SC 3.1.1)
criteria.details: Primary natural language of every page explicitly set via html lang="en".

criteria.name: WCAG-2: Descriptive Page Titles (SC 2.4.2)
criteria.details: Unique, descriptive titles present on all screens.

criteria.name: WCAG-3: Zero Document Horizontal Overflow (SC 1.4.10 Reflow)
criteria.details: All 30 viewport configurations reflow seamlessly without horizontal scrollbars.

criteria.name: WCAG-4: Non-Text Content Has Alternative Text (SC 1.1.1)
criteria.details: Image elements provide descriptive alt text for screen readers.

criteria.name: WCAG-5: Viewport Reflow and Scalability (SC 1.4.4)
criteria.details: No user-scalable=no lock on landing and editorial pages, permitting assistive zoom.
